# bbd.sh

> A small studio that helps founders, operators, and VCs validate the business and ship the product. End-to-end incubation, full-stack engineering, AI tooling, and flexible terms.

bbd.sh is a small builder studio. We work across the full lifecycle — from validating the business model, through brand and product, to launch and growth. We use modern AI tooling to compress engineering cycles and ship more per project. We'll incubate any digital product with a real business behind it: SaaS, AI agents, browser extensions, mobile apps, content products, ecommerce tools, dev tools, and more.

**Engagement is open** — project fee, revenue share, equity, or hybrid. Each deal is structured around the situation. Best fit: founders, operators, or VC partners with both capital and conviction.

- [Contact](https://bbd.sh/contact): how to send us an idea, a portco, or a co-build pitch

## Stack

frontend: Astro / Next.js / SvelteKit / Tailwind / shadcn/ui · v0 · Cursor
backend: FastAPI / Hono / Bun · PostgreSQL + pgvector · Redis · Edge functions
ai: OpenAI · Anthropic Claude · DeepSeek · LangGraph · MCP · LoRA · multi-model routing
deploy: Cloudflare Pages · Vercel · Fly.io · Edge-first
design: Figma · Midjourney · Flux · in-house brand kit
